description: Transaction-level payment processing data used for merchant, partner, regional and operational analytics.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for a payment transaction.

transaction_amount.business_definition: Gross monetary value associated with a payment attempt.

processing_time_ms.business_definition: Elapsed processing time for a payment transaction.

status.description: Final processing status of the transaction.
status.business_definition: Indicates whether the transaction succeeded or failed.

payment_method.description: Payment method used for the transaction.
payment_method.business_definition: Payment instrument or method used by the customer.

created_at.description: Timestamp at which the transaction was created.

incident_flag.description: Indicates whether the transaction occurred during a known incident period.
incident_flag.business_definition: Operational incident indicator used for root-cause analysis.
